paragraph_checks.reviewed_text: The US case is improving inflation with a less comfortable margin for earnings disappointment. Reuters reports that May inflation cooled, improving hopes for a Federal Reserve cut, while its account of the June policy meeting says officials still envisaged only one cut this year. The combination supports selective duration exposure; it does not establish an imminent easing cycle. [[n1725]] [[n2231]] Companies have to bridge the interval between relief in the inflation rate and relief in household financing costs. That makes a business with controllable expenses more attractive than a business whose recovery requires consumers suddenly to become less price sensitive.
